scope: Only cape/collar and sleeve/cuff clothing weights; real hand/head/neck skin, all74bones and hair are preserved.

collar.method: Only verified cape/sleeve Head/Neck bleed; harmonic interpolation from clean clothing neighbors; no top4 truncation

cuffs.method: Only two complete clothing sleeve/cuff islands. Reconstruct the wrist/forearm/finger mass with a uniform anatomical wrist gradient; preserve all other weights.
